claim: The owner: a lantern on a chain may be hung so its chain sinks into the ceiling; and a skeleton on a chain may be lifted so part of the chain goes into the ceiling.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-21: 'lanterns on chain, you can simply let it sink into ceiling and it looks good' (quoted in bloodmap/light_stage.py:356 and projects/blood-city/references/sewer-design.md). The skeleton half ('That skeleton on chain can be lifted up so part of the chain goes inside ceiling, but it doesn't matter') was said to the agent in conversation the same day and is not quoted in the repository.
use: Read a-chained-thing-is-hung-by-its-body for how we apply it.
